source_issues_and_uncertainties.mathematical_adjudication: For each height-one branch ideal with inertia order e_i, the Kummer base change x^s=f must have ramification index divisible by e_i for Abhyankar’s lemma to kill all tame inertia. Taking lcm(e_i) has this property and still divides |G|; gcd(e_i) does not in general. Thus the French p.g.c.d. is mathematically suspect, while the English lcm is the appropriate version for the argument.
source_issues_and_uncertainties.safe_action: Keep Chinese 最小公倍数 and the chosen English lcm. Explicitly disclose French p.g.c.d. instead of changing Chinese to gcd; no mathematical correction to the current target is justified here.

source_issues_and_uncertainties.target_quote: 都可选取\emph{有限}个仿射开子集 $X_i$, 其像覆盖 $Y$, 以覆盖 $X$
source_issues_and_uncertainties.french_evidence: French likewise says X se recouvre par un nombre fini d’ouverts affines X_i dont les images recouvrent Y.
source_issues_and_uncertainties.analysis: In the universally open surjective case, X need not be quasi-compact: an infinite disjoint union of points over one point is a counterexample to a finite affine cover of X. It is enough for the descent reduction to choose finitely many affine opens whose images cover affine Y. The Chinese accurately follows both English and French.
source_issues_and_uncertainties.action: No Chinese-only edit recommended; retain as a disclosed original proof-wording issue unless coordinator expressly records a mathematical editorial correction.
